summary: Several Manager screens work smoothly again, from committing to creating a new admin.

fixes.title: Commit all includes queued actions
fixes.text: Commit all now also commits queued actions such as a Temporary Access Pass re-issue or a revoke.

fixes.title: New admin and Give access work again
fixes.text: Both buttons work again, and Role lookup finds roles such as Exchange Administrator on the hosted Manager.

fixes.title: Wizards help avoid duplicates
fixes.text: The Entra role picker hides roles that already have a delegation group, and Workload suggests workloads already in use.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Dialogs open on top, the change queue can show recent commits, and informational notes no longer raise the yellow banner.
